dashboard.label: TA-journald Overview
dashboard.description: Collects journald log-plane metadata: journal disk usage (journalctl --disk-usage), journal file count under /var/log/journal, total journal size, age of the oldest journal file,

panel.title: Commercial use of TA-journald requires a paid license (evaluation, personal, lab use free)

search.query: | makeresults | eval buy="Buy License at bentleypc.com/TA-journald", terms="License and Terms at bentleypc.com/TA-journald/LICENSE.html" | fields buy terms

panel.title: License status (click "Open License Setup page" to paste your key)

search.query: index=main sourcetype="ta_license:status" latest=now earliest=-48h | stats latest(_time) as seen, latest(status) as status, latest(message) as note by host | eval last_reported=strftime(seen,"%F %H:%M"), setup="Open License Setup page - paste your key" | append [ | makeresults | eval host="this deployment", status="no data yet", note="beacon reports hourly once a key is set", last_reported="n/a", setup="Open License Setup page - paste your key" ] | table host status last_reported note setup | sort host
| mstats avg("journald.size_mb") as value where index=metrics span=5m | fields - _time | tail 1
| mstats avg("journald.file_count") as value where index=metrics span=5m | fields - _time | tail 1
| mstats avg("journald.oldest_age_hours") as value where index=metrics span=5m | fields - _time | tail 1
| mstats avg("journald.service_active") as value where index=metrics span=5m | fields - _time | tail 1
index=main sourcetype="journald:status" | dedup host | table host size_mb disk_kb file_count oldest_age_hours service_active
